_about: English word -> Devanagari respelling used for IndicF5 (which cannot pronounce Latin-script English). Nukta letters use letter + U+093C (NFC form), the same form already validated in earlier runs. f is always फ़ (never plain फ = aspirated p); z is always ज़.

a (article).why: v1 used अ (a lone schwa vowel, rare as a Hindi word) and the article was dropped twice. ए gives the full /eɪ/ form of 'a', which is standard English and much harder to swallow.

Prudential.why: Unchanged from v1/welcome tests, where Whisper recognised it every time (pru-DEN-shee-al, Indian-English pronunciation).

Health.why: Unchanged; recognised correctly in all runs.

India.why: Unchanged; audit scoring favoured 'India' over 'in India'.

healthcare.why: One word, as in the script.

healthier.why: द for English voiced 'th' (ð), the standard Devanagari choice.

simple.why: Explicit म्प cluster (sim-pl) instead of the nasal sign in सिंपल; plus chunk-final danda to stop the 'simpler' release heard in v1.

technology.why: ॉ (candra o) for the English open 'o' in -nol-.

transforming.why: फ़ added for consistent f (v1 had plain फ).

accessible.why: ऐ for the English /æ/ in ac-.

personalized.why: ज़ for z; final ्ड keeps the -zd ending.

of.why: फ़ for consistent f (v1 had plain फ).

through.why: थ is the closest supported sound to English θ.
